Sanitized at the source: share-preview.ts passes each repository remote through sanitizeRemoteUrl (plan-share-repos.ts), which clears userinfo, query and fragment and drops file: URLs and absolute paths. controller-remote-urls-golden pins the userinfo and token-query cases (CAN-7082).

ticketed.reason: (c) app-advisor:tool-request carries a Git remote URL as action input, unredacted.

(d) A user-saved MCP server's URL can carry a credential, and mcp-servers:save-server takes it back from the controller, so it needs CAN-7082's write-side merge before it can be stripped. Detected and plugin-bundled servers' URLs are out-only and projected.
(g) The agent's browser.wait_for target in an interface-tool call the controller's renderer runs. CAN-7082 refuses controller-run tool inputs that carry URLs (its third PR).
User-entered project start page URL (ProjectStartPage kind url); it can carry a token in its query and round-trips through projects:save.
OAuth authorization endpoint on a user-saved MCP server; user-entered, so it can carry a token in its query.
OAuth token endpoint on a user-saved MCP server; user-entered, so it can carry a token in its query.

refused.reason: An embedded mcp-servers:start-account mints an authenticated portal link for this computer's cloud account. The host session refuses every controller request on the channel that is not the external sign-in, before it reaches main, so no link is minted or sent; the external sign-in returns no embeddedUrl.
